purpose: Evaluate the qualified borrowed-integer leaf repair across the complete existing independent library cost matrix, against both unchanged main and the unchanged previous full-cache combination.
runtime_source: Reuse the frozen 10134-file qualified candidate without edits. Build its production libraries in a fresh target. Create only a separate 10135-file metadata copy by appending the original cfg(test) module declaration and copying the identical original 296-line harness.
prior_artifacts: Reuse 22 original binaries and two groups of five libraries, each guarded by actual file hashes and source maps. Preserve every qualification target, binary, result and previous sample.
driver_identity: Use all 18 original probe source files unchanged at their original paths; the parser is copied verbatim from the closed cache-free runner. No fixtures, mathematical expected values, representation inventories, output assertions, counts or timing windows change.
qualification: Retain the qualified 876 scalar tests and all-feature/all-target scalar Clippy evidence for the identical source; record whether the new scalar library bytes match the qualification library.
Strict all-feature hypercurve library/test Clippy for the new metadata build.
Three original metadata regression tests in each group, plus all five endpoint regression tests in the candidate.
All 30 preflights and all nine 210-receipt abort-control processes precede costs.
schedule: For each original suite/mode: six fresh rounds, one process per group in the declared order. The six orders cover every permutation; each group occupies each position twice. CPU 0, no concurrent builds or other agent measurements.
allocator_policy: Public time probes use System without counting; memory probes record requested Rust allocations over System. Private metadata probes retain their original TLS wrapper even in time mode. No CLI allocator is imposed on reusable-library consumers.
assessment: Reparse all 237 process outputs from the original logs, verify declared order/commands/counts/witnesses, all historical 231 broad witnesses and all 210 abort receipts in every control. Report all 1095 timing comparisons, 402 allocation comparisons and 33 binary-size comparisons. Keep all six paired values; report memory repeatability and every adverse row.
sampling_policy: No filtering, replacement, extension, adaptive thresholds or pooling with historical data. Ratios and paired directions are descriptive, not statistical significance. Allocation-phase durations remain raw and are not timing results.
environment: Retain compiler/RUSTFLAGS/CPU information and per-command CPU0 governor/frequency snapshots. No host setting changes, calibrated frequency estimate or claim about historical host conditions.
remaining_gates: This library trial cannot establish whole-application costs or satisfy the original native 120-second worker-CPU board and 60-second check-body wall neck gates. Earlier regressions and failures remain. All other properties.md work remains in scope.
